purpose: Regression guard for the joint Laplace Poisson GLMM ncit ~ opposition + biopharm + (1 | year), which failed on macOS arm64 with 'joint GLMM starting conditional-mode solve did not converge'. Near the conditional mode a fixed-beta Newton step changes the PIRLS criterion by less than its rounding error (~3e-10 on ~1.2e4 for these 4809 rows), so the objective-only line search rejected the step on platform-dependent rounding and the solve stalled above the 1e-8 score tolerance at the fast-PIRLS start.
source: Columns ncit, opposition, biopharm, year of the m-clark 'patents' data shipped with the mixeff R package (tests/fixtures/mclark_patents.RData, md5 69d70e0e53ed9b94b86b75eff85eb76c; 4809 rows, 18 years).
regenerate: e <- new.env(); load('mclark_patents.RData', envir = e); dat <- get(ls(e)[1], e); write.csv(data.frame(ncit = dat$ncit, opposition = dat$opposition, biopharm = dat$biopharm, year = as.character(dat$year)), 'mclark_patents_poisson.csv', row.names = FALSE)
